title: Sam and the Big Pot
learning_objectives: Decode CVC words with short a and short o
Read the irregular word 'the' by sight
parent_prompts: Point to each word. Let the child sound it out; do not say it first.
If the child looks at the picture to guess, cover the picture and try again.

pages.image_alt: A child named Sam holds a large pot.
The pot sits on a stove with steam rising.

pages.text: Sam is not sad. Sam has a lid.
pages.image_alt: Sam holds up a round lid and smiles.
pages.audio_script: Sam is not sad. Sam has a lid.

pages.text: The lid is on the pot. Sam can nap.
pages.image_alt: The lid covers the pot. Sam rests on a mat.
pages.audio_script: The lid is on the pot. Sam can nap.

quiz.explanation: Page 1 says: Sam has a pot.
h-o-t. The middle sound is short o, and the last sound is t.

options.text: Sam has a lid to put on the hot pot.

quiz.explanation: The pot is hot (page 2), but Sam has a lid (page 3), so Sam can cover it and does not need to be sad.

activities.prompt: Match each word to its meaning.

pairs.right: a top that covers a pot

off_screen_prompt: Find three things at home that have a lid.

review.decodability_note: 'Sam', 'sad', 'can', 'nap', 'lid' rely on prerequisite short-a/short-i CVC; 'lid' (short i) flagged by checker and accepted after review.
